limitations: Machine policy outcomes are not human win rates, retention or device performance.
Selected chassis bulwark, difficulty 0; only normal routes; events skipped. Non-scavenger runs assume prior unlocks.
Only normal game APIs buy, equip, sell, upgrade, repair, collect rewards and advance waves. No granted equipment, currency, HP or forced victories.
Active core counts require equipped weapons and active support links. Module presence alone remains separately reported.
At most two paid rerolls per shop; a deterministic, bounded policy may miss valid packing, transitions or purchases.
Each family expresses an equipment preference; missing cores remain missing and every failed run is retained.
Combat uses fixed 1/60 steps and a visible-state pilot at 10 Hz. Its accurate geometric avoidance is stronger than typical human play.
No rendering or human preparation delays: combat time excludes real browsing and decision time.
Every battle lasting ten seconds is saved/restored through production validation, then compared with an uninterrupted branch for up to two seconds.
The seed reproduces RNG under the same rules and choices; the report is not a full input replay or importable save.
